components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-header { color: var(--ivory, #f2f0e9); background: var(--ink, #0b0b0c); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-dark, #3d3d40); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-header-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-6, 24px); min-height: 82px; padding-inline: var(--gutter, clamp(22px, 5.5vw, 80px)); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: var(--font-label, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .13em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-navigation { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-6, 24px); } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; color: inherit; font-family: var(--font-label, "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .09em; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; text-decoration: none; cursor: default; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-nav-contact { display: none; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-header-inner { flex-wrap: wrap; min-height: 76px; padding-block: var(--space-4, 16px); gap: var(--space-3, 12px); } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-navigation { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0 var(--space-6, 24px); padding-top: var(--space-3, 12px); border-top: 1px solid var(--line-dark, #3d3d40); } .ds-nav-contact { display: inline-flex; } }

narrative.overview:
Tension Lab Fitness pairs condensed uppercase headings with generous near-black and warm ivory planes. Anton establishes the strong display voice; Barlow Condensed carries the wordmark, navigation, row headings, and square actions. Helvetica keeps explanations, reviews, and forms readable. This is the condensed-heading mockup direction chosen by the user on October 12, 2026, superseding the earlier pure-white and all-Helvetica draft.

Large training imagery establishes atmosphere, while original client photographs and attributed accounts supply evidence. Fine dividers and spacing structure the flat pages. A single restrained homepage image reveal provides motion; the rest of the interface uses direct color changes and native disclosures. The durable system is extracted from the implemented site; page-specific composition lives in `.impeccable/surfaces/full-site.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, warm ivory, and muted gray surfaces.
Anton display headings, Barlow Condensed controls, and Helvetica body copy.
Square controls, fine rules, flat sections, and visible keyboard focus.
Large illustrative training imagery alongside original, attributed client evidence.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use ink and ivory for the primary hierarchy; retain muted gray for supporting text and fine rules for separation. CTA emphasis comes from contrast, not an orange or blue accent.

rules.name: The Type Roles Rule
rules.body: Use Anton for display hierarchy, Barlow Condensed for navigation and actions, and Helvetica for sustained reading. Preserve the natural widths of all three families.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate content through surface contrast, spacing, and rules rather than decorative shadows or floating cards.

dos: Do use near-black and warm ivory with the documented Anton, Barlow Condensed, and Helvetica roles.
Do preserve square controls, visible keyboard focus, and the established responsive spacing.
Do retain original client photographs, review attribution, and the About stock-photo credit.
Do describe inquiry actions as preparing, copying, or opening a draft for the visitor to send.
donts: Don't restore the superseded pure-white, all-Helvetica direction or add orange or blue CTAs.
Don't horizontally scale type, introduce decorative shadows, or round the established square controls.
Don't present generated or stock imagery as a real client, Sam, or his training location.
Don't invent result metrics, credentials, prices, contact details, or a message-sent state.
